govdocs-archive_org-nsia-AtzenhofferAnth: This FBI interview of Anthony Atzenhoffer Jr. is a Bureau file from the JFK case. The declassified interview is a primary source. The Bureau interviewed hundreds of witnesses. Each witness added a piece. Researchers value such files. The file belongs to the assassination archive.
myths-and-legends-of-our-own-land-volume: Manhattan and its neighbors get the folklore treatment in this volume, from Dutch New Amsterdam tales to Revolutionary hauntings. Skinner proves that even the most modern American city stands on ground thick with old stories. An enchanting guide to the ghosts and legends hiding behind New York's streets.
